messages:
Emily: starting observability bring-up for eu-central4 (gpu-pool). short thread for checks + owners. pinging infra, oncall, billing. please ack when you complete your step.
Rajeev: I’ll own metrics + dashboards. will push prometheus values and the grafana provisioning job.
Maria: logs & traces owner. I’ll wire fluent-bit -> loki and otel collector -> tempo. also adding cost gating alerts.
Alex: network + nodepool sizing. opening peering and firewall tickets now.
sre-bot: created INF-8961 observability-bootstrap-euc4
Emily: goals: logs -> central Loki tenant, metrics -> Thanos remote_write, traces -> Tempo OTLP, provision minimal grafana dashboards, add alert templates + runbook links. cost-gate: alert if GPU nodes exceed 25% of quota for sustained 15m.
Rajeev: prometheus helm notes: set remote_write.url=https://thanos-write.prod.redwood:443, add relabel cluster=eu-central4, ensure node-exporter + kube-state metrics scrapes enabled. also include scrape_timeout tweaks for heavy nodes.
Maria: fluent-bit config: tenant_id=redwood-eu-central4, enable filesystem buffering (storage.path=/var/log/flb-storage), set buffer_limit 64MB, drop logs with label debug=true. otel-collector: add resource.attributes.region=eu-central4 to spans.
Alex: network tasks: NET-5437 created for VPC peering to central-observability, firewall allow outbound 443 to thanos.prod.redwood and 4318 to tempo. note: AWS ENI limits in eu-central4 are tight — use mixed instance types for gpu pool.
Emily: alert rule draft for prometheus (to add into prometheusRule helm values):
```
- alert: GPUPoolHighUtil
  expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests_gpu{cluster=\"eu-central4\"}) / sum(kube_node_status_capacity{resource=\"nvidia.com/gpu\",cluster=\"eu-central4\"}) > 0.8
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: \"High GPU utilization in eu-central4\"
    runbook: \"https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-saturation\"
```
Rajeev: nit: prefer using sum by (pool) and compare allocatable not capacity. also add a recording rule for gpu:utilization to keep queries cheap.
Maria: traces: tempo requires header X-Scope-OrgID=observability. otel-collector must include auth token; confirm secret mounted. I’ll add region label to span attributes so tracing teams can filter.
Alex: peering complete (NET-5437) and firewall rule applied. validated connectivity: `nc -z thanos.prod.redwood 443` returned 0.
deploy-bot: deployment started monitoring-stack/eu-central4 v1.8.0 -> pods: prometheus, loki-collector, otel-collector, grafana (rolling).
Emily: pre-handoff validation steps (run from bastion):
- prometheus: `kubectl get prometheus -n monitoring` should show READY
- remote_write: curl Thanos write health or check metrics appear in thanos: `up{cluster=\"eu-central4\"}`
- logs: `kubectl logs loki-collector-<pod>` check push success lines
- traces: `otel-cli --endpoint https://tempo.prod.redwood:4318/v1/traces -n observability` send test span and verify in Tempo
- grafana: load GPU Utilization dashboard and verify panels show data in last 5m
Rajeev: metrics validation: node-exporter and kube-state are scraped; I see metrics in Thanos within 60s. pushed a recording rule and a basic dashboard JSON to infra/grafana/dashboards.
Maria: logs flowing. noticed one node spiking kubelet logs — added fluent-bit drop rule for kubelet.level=debug and confirmed decrease in log volume. traces accepted by tempo after adding header.
Billing-bot: billing alert draft created: https://git.redwood/billing-alerts/pulls/47 referencing INF-8961
Emily: cost gating details: condition -> if gpu_node_count > committed_quota * 0.25 for 15m then notify #cost-ops and page on escalation path. maria will merge PR.
Alex: nodepool sizing note: initial pool = 6 g4dn-like instances (mix of g4dn & g5) to spread ENI usage and avoid EC2 limits. set maxSurge to 1 and autoscaler profiles conservative.
Emily: outstanding before handoff to SRE:
- synthetic alert smoke test (SRE) to ensure routing and escalation
- add runbook links to all alert annotations
- merge billing gating PR
- add GPU saturation playbook draft to runbooks repo
Rajeev: I’ll add dashboard provisioning job to infra repo so new clusters get dashboards installed automatically.
Maria: I’ll open the GPU saturation playbook draft now and link into the runbook annotations.
Alex: oncall note for SRE: if GPUPoolHighUtil fires -> step1 scale nodepool +2, step2 cordon low-priority workloads, step3 engage capacity team.
emily: plan to mark INF-8961 ready-for-sre-handoff tomorrow 09:00 UTC if all checks pass. ack with thumbs when you’ve completed your tasks.
sre-bot: INF-8961 status -> ready-for-sre-handoff
Emily: thanks everyone — solid work. will do final signoff in morning. :rocket:
